lines.zh: 我有两格多高，走起来有分量。
lines.en: I stand over two blocks, and I walk heavy.

lines.zh: 白桦林里我的影子很长。
lines.en: My shadow runs long in the birch wood.
I walk with my wings folded.
A scorpion's hook ends my tail.
The birch bark is very white.
I leave claw marks on the trunks.

lines.zh: 这一片林子我走过很多次。
lines.en: I have walked this wood many times.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，鬃毛上的叶子掉下来。
lines.en: I shake my head and leaves fall from my mane.
A feather drops onto the leaves.

lines.zh: 我停下，耳朵朝着你的方向。
lines.en: I stop and turn my ears your way.
The birch leaves are rustling.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，声音很闷。
lines.en: My steps in the leaves are muffled.
My foreclaws are larger than my hind ones.

lines.zh: 树影一段一段从我背上过去。
lines.en: Tree shadows pass over my back in strips.
I stand between two trees.
My wings half open, then fold.
The proportions of this body are strange.
But I am long used to it.

lines.zh: 白桦的白色在夜里发灰。
lines.en: The birch white turns grey at night.

lines.zh: 我趴着，尾刺有一搭没一搭地敲。
lines.en: I lie down, my stinger tapping now and then.
I look up at the tops of the birches.

lines.zh: 风一过，白色的树皮就晃。
lines.en: The white bark sways when the wind passes.
There is a tuft at the tip of my tail.
I curl it round to look at it.

lines.zh: 白桦林很少有这么静的。
lines.en: The birches are rarely this still.
I narrow my eyes and sway my tail.
I lower my head onto my foreclaws.
There is nothing to do at this hour.

lines.zh: 影子这么长，装不下别人。
lines.en: My shadow's too long to share.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后甩了一下。
lines.en: My tail whips once behind me.
You look up at me.

lines.zh: 我有一张不太好看的脸。
lines.en: My face is not a pleasant one.
You will get used to it.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着白桦叶的泥。
lines.en: Your boots are muddy with birch leaves.
You came from beyond the wood.
There is no path here.

lines.zh: 白桦林尽头，你走过头了。
lines.en: You walked too far into my birches.
You set your pack down.
That means you plan to stay.
I advise you against it.
You rest a hand on your pack.
What is in that pack?
I will not ask.
Your face says you are guilty.
A low sound rolls from deep in my throat.
There is a wound on my chest.
A few feathers fall.
I got up.
I retreat behind a birch.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了一下，我照样站直。
lines.en: A wing folds wrong, and I still stand tall.

lines.zh: 鬃毛全竖起来，我低声吼。
lines.en: My mane bristles and I growl low.

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出白气，我伏得更低。
lines.en: White breath shoots from my nostrils as I crouch lower.
I lower my head to take the blow.
I tuck my wings back.
That thing in your hands.
It smells like meat.
On the ground is fine.

lines.zh: 你后退了，我却往前走一步。
lines.en: You step back; I step forward.
And I will call you a friend.
You held the meat up.
My neck will not reach.
A touch lower still.
Your hand is trembling.
On the leaves is fine.
You threw the meat to the ground.
I lowered my head and ate it.
You struck my foreleg.
I did not shift at all.

lines.zh: 我的前腿抵住你，纹丝不动。
lines.en: My foreleg braces against you and does not budge.
Walk round the side.
Your shoulder met my chest.
I will not give way.

lines.zh: 肩一顶，你被弹进灌木里。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder and you fly into the bushes.
My scorpion tail grazed you.
You passed beside me.

lines.zh: 你被我的翅膀推了一下。
lines.en: My wing shoved you once.
For a thing shaped like me, no.
There is only me in this birch wood.

lines.zh: 我这张脸不适合那种事。
lines.en: This face of mine does not suit that.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺离你只剩一寸。
lines.en: My stinger is an inch from you.
Not even the birds here approach me.
There is no second one in this wood.
I have looked already.
I am not the master of this wood.
I only live here.

lines.zh: 这种事，先问我的尾刺答不答应。
lines.en: Ask my tail stinger whether it agrees first.
There is a feather on the ground.
That's mine. Don't pick it up.

lines.zh: 我用爪子拨了拨，觉得能吃。
lines.en: I paw at it and decide it is edible.
Then I tossed it away.
I rake it over with a claw.
There is some mud on it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，羽毛全炸开。
lines.en: I bite down and my feathers flare.
This is certainly no meat.
Manticoremon's hoof grinds into the dirt.

lines.zh: 我把它留在一块石头上。
lines.en: I leave it on a stone.
Your hand moved to your belt.
Then there is nothing to discuss.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，我挡住整片林光。
lines.en: My wings open and blot out the forest light.
The shadow covers you at once.
I ready Death Claw.

lines.zh: 盯上你了，我就不打算放。
lines.en: I have you in sight and I will not let go.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我的蝎尾先动。
lines.en: In the birches, my scorpion tail moves first.
My claws are harder.
Run if you wish.
The birches will trip you.
I raise a foreleg.
You will remember this stance.
I circle rings about you.

lines.zh: 翅膀展开有我的身长那么宽。
lines.en: My wingspan is as wide as I am tall.

lines.zh: 你被翅膀的影子扫过两次。
lines.en: My wing shadow passes over you twice.
I wait for you to raise a hand.

lines.zh: 我跳上树干，从上面看你。
lines.en: I leap to a trunk and look down at you.
You cannot tell where I am.

lines.zh: 叶子把我的位置盖住了。
lines.en: The leaves hide where I am.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树换到那棵树。
lines.en: I move from this tree to that one.
One wingbeat carries me over.
You turn in circles below.
I see it quite distinctly.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，就看见我的尾刺。
lines.en: You look up and see my stinger.
My claws come down.

lines.zh: 死亡之爪落在地上，土翻起来。
lines.en: Death Claw strikes the earth and it turns.
You retreat quickly.
I take one step after you.
One wing sweep and the wind flips you over.

lines.zh: 爪子按住你，尾刺抬起来。
lines.en: My paws pin you and my stinger rises.
A claw rests on your chest.
I held back on that one.
My foreclaw rakes down.
Your bracer splits.
I rear up on my forelegs.
You are forced back.
A gust passes over the birch wood.

lines.zh: 白桦林间，我的翅膀先露出来。
lines.en: Between the birches my wings come out first.
My wings brush the treetops.
The white here is too bright.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，土震了一下。
lines.en: I land and the ground jolts.

lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀，落在白桦枝上。
lines.en: I beat my wings and land on a birch branch.
I land only after seeing clearly.

lines.zh: 白桦的皮在我爪下掉了一块。
lines.en: A strip of birch bark peels under my claw.
There are old scratches on the tree.
Not from today.
I land between two birches.
The ground takes a dent.
I land in a clearing.
The birches are denser here.

lines.zh: 火燎到翅膀，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔下来，撞断一棵白桦。
lines.en: I fall from the air and snap a birch.
Water pours in; I swim for the light.

lines.zh: 爆风把落叶卷起来，我退了半步。
lines.en: The blast swirls the leaves and I give half a step.
Something sharp burrows into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那法术压住了我的翅膀。
lines.en: That spell pins my wings.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候爪子抬不高。
lines.en: When hungry, I cannot raise my claws high.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的翅膀上，羽毛全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my wing and every feather stands.
The leaves beneath me vanish.
